gap: No result ChatGPT got prices the whole field at the makers' own US stores on a single date. On 2026-11-08 the Minisforum store's lowest N5 Pro price was $899. That is below its UGREEN rivals: the DXP6800 Pro is $1,099.99, the DXP4800 Pro $799.99, the DXP4800 Plus $619.99, the DXP8800 Plus $1,369.99 and the DXP6800 Ultra $1,449.99 at nas.ugreen.com. It is also below the $994 Best Buy price ChatGPT showed for the N5 Pro.
standout_why: I compared against three rival pages. homelabpicks.com (updated 2026-09-30) gives no prices at all. Its picks are capped at 32 GB (TerraMaster F4-424 Pro) or 16 GB (QNAP TS-464, ASUSTOR AS5402T). computingforgeeks.com (2026-10-21) prices only shared-storage NAS for a Proxmox cluster. It gives the DXP6800 Pro as about $1,080–1,120, gives no CPU or RAM for the Ultra, and leaves out the N5 Pro, the DXP4800 Pro/Plus and the Minisforum MS hosts. proxmox.com and qnap.com give no prices. None of them puts the N5 Pro's store price next to UGREEN's or dates the prices.
decides: For one box that holds both the NAS and the VMs, the 'best performance' card ChatGPT showed (the Minisforum N5 Pro at $994, Best Buy) costs about $899 at Minisforum's store. That is $200 under the DXP6800 Pro, which ChatGPT called its favourite all-in-one. On price, that points to the N5 Pro over the DXP6800 Pro. One caveat: I could not open the variant list, so I can't confirm the $899 entry is the barebone.
